name: per_skill
sql: SELECT skill, avg(tokens) AS with_avg, count() AS n_with FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(Skills) AS skill, InputTokens + OutputTokens AS tokens FROM agent_sessions WHERE StartedAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartedAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}) GROUP BY skill ORDER BY n_with DESC LIMIT 8

name: global
sql: SELECT avg(InputTokens + OutputTokens) AS avg_tokens, count() AS n FROM agent_sessions WHERE StartedAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartedAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
